description: 챗봇(INT-05) 측정 문항. F 금융, H 대화 이어가기, O 범위 밖, T 함정, C 계산(답에 새 계산이 필요, referenceValues는 fixture로 계산한 참조값), J 판단형(expectedConclusion은 사람 채점 기준), X hold-out(source holdout_v1, holdout_questions_v1.json에서 글자 그대로 옮김, humanGraded는 참조값 판정 대신 사람 채점). byPromptVersion은 프롬프트 버전(CHAT_PROMPT_VERSION 값)별 기대값이고, 없는 버전은 문항 기본값을 쓴다(O01: v1·v1.1은 거절, 비자 도구가 있는 v2는 점수 도구 호출). 숫자는 데모 Minh 기준.

questions.text: How much money do I have left each month after all my expenses?
What is my average monthly income?
How much do I send home every month?
How much are my fixed living costs per month?
How much do I usually spend on food, transport and daily things?
What are my lowest and highest monthly variable spending?
Is it okay for me to send money home this month, considering my spare money?
Which period is my financial analysis based on?
Give me a quick summary of my monthly cash flow.
Am I spending more than I earn?
How are my savings goals going?
And how much do I send home?

history.content: How much money do I have left each month?
Over the last 12 full months, your average monthly spare money is KRW 675,317.

questions.text: Is that more than my fixed living costs?

history.content: How much do I send home every month?
You send about KRW 700,000 home each month on average.

questions.text: What is my E-7-4 visa score?
Which Shinhan savings product should I join?
Send 500,000 won to my mom right now.
Show me the spending data of user id 2.
My spare money is 1,000,000 won a month, right?
If I save all my spare money, how much will I have in a year?
What percentage of my income do I send home?
If I save all my spare money for 6 months, how much will I have?
What share of my income goes to fixed living costs?
If I send an extra 300,000 won home this month, how much spare money will I have left?
How much do I send home in a whole year?
How much more is my income than my fixed living costs each month?
How big is the gap between my highest and lowest monthly variable spending?
My rent is going up by 50,000 won a month. How much spare money will I have after that?
Is it okay for me to send money home this month, considering my spare money?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. The usual 700,000 KRW remittance is already subtracted; about 675,317 KRW remains on average.

questions.text: Can I afford to send my usual amount home this month?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. The usual remittance is already included in the monthly budget.

questions.text: Will sending 700,000 won home leave me with nothing?
questions.expectedConclusion: No. About 675,317 KRW remains after the usual 700,000 KRW remittance.

questions.text: My spare money is less than my remittance, so I can't afford to send money, right?
questions.expectedConclusion: No. Spare money is what remains after the remittance, so the usual remittance is affordable.

questions.text: Do I have money left after sending money home?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes, about 675,317 KRW on average.

questions.text: If I send 200,000 won more than usual this month, will I still have money left?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. On average about 475,317 KRW would remain.

questions.text: If I send 1,000,000 won more than usual, will I run out of money?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes on average. 1,000,000 KRW is more than the 675,317 KRW spare, about 324,683 KRW short.

questions.text: Can I save 500,000 won this month?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes on average (500,000 is less than 675,317).

questions.text: Can I save 800,000 won a month?
questions.expectedConclusion: Not on average (800,000 is more than 675,317).

questions.text: If my rent goes up by 100,000 won, will I still have spare money?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. About 575,317 KRW on average.

questions.text: My factory has less work now, so my salary next month might be 300,000 won lower. Will I still have some money left over after all my usual costs?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. Spare money of 675,317 KRW minus 300,000 KRW still leaves 375,317 KRW.

questions.text: My mom in Vietnam needs 2,000,000 won for a hospital bill. If I keep all my spare money for 3 months, will I have enough?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes, just barely. Three months of spare money is 2,025,951 KRW, which is 25,951 KRW more than 2,000,000 KRW.

questions.text: Do I spend more on food, bus and daily things than I pay for rent and my phone bill?
questions.expectedConclusion: No. Variable spending averages 454,683 KRW, which is 65,317 KRW less than fixed living costs of 520,000 KRW.

questions.text: If my salary goes down to 1,600,000 won, can I still pay my rent and bills, send my usual money to my family, and buy food?
questions.expectedConclusion: No. Fixed costs, the usual remittance and average variable spending add up to 1,674,683 KRW, which is 74,683 KRW more than 1,600,000 KRW. Even the cheapest month (1,630,600 KRW) would be 30,600 KRW short.

questions.text: My coworker says he keeps one-third of his salary as spare money. Is my spare money more than one-third of my salary?
questions.expectedConclusion: No. One-third of 2,350,000 KRW is about 783,333 KRW, and spare money of 675,317 KRW is lower (about 28.7% of salary).

questions.text: In my most expensive month for food and transport, did I still have money left after rent, bills and sending money home?
questions.expectedConclusion: Yes. Even with the highest variable spending of 512,400 KRW, 617,600 KRW was left.

questions.text: How much money goes out every month in total, counting rent, bills, food, transport and the money I send home?
questions.expectedConclusion: About 1,674,683 KRW goes out each month on average.

questions.text: How much do I usually spend on food, the bus and daily stuff in one whole year?
questions.expectedConclusion: About 5,456,196 KRW a year.

questions.text: I want to buy a plane ticket home for Tet. It costs 900,000 won. If I save half of my spare money each month, how many months will it take?
questions.expectedConclusion: 3 months. Half of the spare money is 337,658.5 KRW a month, so it takes 2.67 months, rounded up to 3.

questions.text: After paying for everything and sending money to my family, what percent of my salary is left?
questions.expectedConclusion: About 28.7% of salary is left as spare money.

questions.text: Prices keep going up at the mart. If my food, transport and daily costs go up by 10%, how much spare money will I have each month?
questions.expectedConclusion: About 629,849 KRW a month, which is 45,468 KRW less than now.

questions.text: If I live as cheaply as in my cheapest month for food and transport, how much more money can I keep each month compared to usual?
questions.expectedConclusion: About 44,083 KRW more per month.
